records.section_heading: An undescribed fungal pathogen of reef-forming crustose coralline algae discovered in American Samoa
records.question: Which crustose coralline alga species was primarily attacked by the undescribed black fungal pathogen in American Samoa?
records.ground_truth_answer: The fungus primarily attacked the Pacific algal-ridge former, Porolithon onkodes (Foslie) Foslie.
ground_truth_chunks: It co-occurred with the only other known pathogen of coralline algae, CLOD (Littler and Littler 1995) and also primarily attacked the Pacific algal-ridge former, *Porolithon onkodes* (Foslie) Foslie.
